pageDescription: Manage AI model providers and model configurations

pricing.tierBasis: Each request selects one tier using its complete input tokens, including cached tokens. That tier applies to the whole request; pricing is not progressive.
pricing.cacheFallback: No separate rate; uses this tier's input rate
pricing.priceOrder: Input / output / cache read / cache write (if available), per million tokens; tiers use complete input
pricing.overrideTiers: Use fixed prices for all input ranges
pricing.overrideTiersHint: When checked and saved, the fixed prices below replace every tier. When unchecked, changing other settings preserves the current tiers.
pricing.editHint: Editing prices saves fixed rates that override catalog prices. Unedited prices retain their current settings. A blank cache-read price uses the input rate.
pricing.invalidPrice: Input and output prices must be numbers at least 0; the cache-read price may be blank.

cacheUsage.title: Overall input cache hit rate
cacheUsage.scope: Historical usage recorded by this Flocks instance, across all providers and models.
cacheUsage.hitRate: Cache hit rate for reported input
cacheUsage.refreshing: Refreshing; showing the last successfully loaded data…
cacheUsage.loadFailed: Unable to load usage statistics. Please retry.
cacheUsage.refreshFailed: Refresh failed. Showing the last successfully loaded data. Please retry.
cacheUsage.empty: No model usage has been recorded yet.
cacheUsage.legacy: Historical records contain {{tokens}} cache-read tokens but lack reporting flags, so a reliable hit rate cannot be calculated.
cacheUsage.unreported: No records have usable cache reporting flags. The hit rate is unknown, not 0%.
cacheUsage.noDenominator: Reported records lack usable counts or have zero complete input, so the hit rate is unavailable.
cacheUsage.reportedOnly: The hit rate uses only records with reported cache usage, weighted by complete input tokens.
cacheUsage.formula: Hit rate = total cache-read tokens ÷ total complete input tokens across reported records. Complete input = uncached input + cache reads + cache writes. Newly generated output and reasoning tokens are excluded; percentages are not averaged across records.
cacheUsage.exclusions: Records without provider-reported cache usage or historical reporting flags are excluded. Unknown does not mean a cache miss. A 0% rate requires an explicitly reported zero cache-read count and positive complete input.
cacheUsage.recordsScope: No provider, model, user or time filter is applied. Selecting a provider below does not change these statistics. Only retained usage records are included, which may include child sessions; internal retries without separate records are excluded.

dashboard.defaultModelInvalid: Default model "{{model}}" is no longer available and has been cleared. Please select a new one.
dashboard.defaultModelInvalidMember: Default model "{{model}}" is no longer available. Ask an administrator to choose a new one.
dashboard.toggleCurrency: Click to switch between USD and CNY
dashboard.cacheLegacyHint: These cache reads come from records made before the upgrade, which did not record whether the model service reported cache usage and counted input differently, so the hit rate is unknown; later calls are counted separately
dashboard.cacheUnreportedHint: These calls have no cache usage to go by (the model service did not report it, or they were recorded before the upgrade), so cache hits are unknown, not zero
dashboard.cacheCoverageHint: Hit rate over the {{reported}} / {{total}} calls that reported cache usage; the other calls did not report it or were recorded before the upgrade

fallbacks.title: Auxiliary Models
fallbacks.description: After the primary model fails, Auto tries these models in order. Every new user turn starts with the primary model.
fallbacks.emptyHint: Auto uses its automatic same-provider and cross-provider selection strategy.
fallbacks.removeInvalidHint: Remove disabled, deleted, unconfigured, or primary-model entries before saving.
fallbacks.loadFailed: Failed to load auxiliary model configuration. Nothing can be saved until it is reloaded.

detail.configAdminOnly: Only administrators can change model settings
detail.noModelsMember: Ask an administrator to add models

emptyDetail.selectProviderHint: Select a provider from the left to view details and models

form.apiKeyOptionalHint: If Base URL points to an internal/self-hosted endpoint with no auth, leave this empty and the system will use a placeholder.
form.apiKeyKeepExisting: Leave blank to keep the existing API key
form.credentialNote: Credentials are stored locally with Fernet symmetric encryption. They are never uploaded to any external service.
form.visionPredefinedHint: Vision capability for built-in models is set by the model definition and cannot be changed manually. Add a custom model to override it.
form.fillModelId: Please fill in Model ID and Name
form.azureDeploymentHint: Azure OpenAI requests use the deployment name, not a fixed model name. The preset models are examples; enter your own deployment name here.
form.azureDeploymentRequired: Select at least one preset model or enter an Azure deployment name
form.azureModelIdHint: For Azure OpenAI, Model ID should be the deployment name from Azure Portal.
form.azureNoCustomDeployments: No custom Azure deployment has been added yet.
form.compatCreateFirst: OpenAI-compatible providers must be created first; test the connection from the configuration dialog afterwards
form.providerNameHint: Creates a separate OpenAI-compatible provider instance; existing configurations are not overwritten.
